note: 单元通关专属迷你阅读(科学家主题，独立短文，不在阅读关出现)。短文2-3句+2题，答案转述非照抄，两题覆盖不同位置。

finalReading.passage: As a boy, Thomas Edison was so curious that he once sat on a nest of eggs to see if they would hatch. His many questions often puzzled his teachers, who thought he was a slow learner. But his mother trusted him and taught him at home, turning a restless child into one of the world's greatest inventors.

questions.q: What does the story suggest about Edison as a boy?
options: He was extremely curious about how things worked.
He was afraid of asking questions.
He was the best student in his class.
questions.explanation: 原文 'so curious that he once sat on a nest of eggs' 体现他极为好奇的转述;其余与原文相反。

questions.q: How did Edison's mother help him?
options: She sent him away to a famous school.
She believed in him and taught him herself.
She told him to stop asking questions.
She thought he was a slow learner too.
questions.explanation: 原文 'his mother trusted him and taught him at home' 的转述;'slow learner' 是老师的看法,非母亲。
